title: 第25章 离家之人本性显露第1章 新官上任
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
离家之人，本性显露。
李家，清晨。
“呼~这功法确实是大道至简。”李君肃睁开眼，看着外面微亮的天色想着。
李清风给自己的功法叫做清心自在，功法里关於脉络的运转堪称细致入微，他现在感觉自己的整个人都通透了不少。
就是因为内力运转了全身上下，才会有如此感觉。
“难怪小周天之上还有大周天。”李君肃站起身笑道，而後扭了扭脖子，推开房门。
李君肃洗漱过後，又开始想着春分刀法的招式，而後拔出照寒开始有些迟钝的挥起刀来。
李毅年说的没错，哪怕挥刀出不了神，先练出形也好。
哪怕只是模拟枪，对着你的眼睛来一枪也可以打瞎你。
李君肃在李家永远都是平静，温润如玉的。
起床，练武，总是如此。
翌日
“该出发了。”李君肃看着外面微亮的天色，换上何穗亲手缝制的衣物，背上不大的包裹，推开门。
李家，大厅。
“来了君肃，来。”大长老看着踏入大厅的李君肃，招了招手。
“大长老？”李君肃走上前，有些疑惑的开口。
“拿着。”大长老掏出一个瓷瓶，塞进李君肃的手里。
“小”李君肃看着瓷瓶上的标识刚想开口，大长老就嘘了一声。
“自己拿好，在外面，要更加刻苦修炼了。”大长老拍了拍李君肃的手。
他不想李君肃加入六扇门，但他也知道，这小小的清风城留不下李君肃。

这里太小，不管是资源，还是对手。
他相信，李君肃一定能成为一方豪杰的。
哪怕李君肃没有那麽争气，他也这麽相信，就像相信李君豪能够独当一面一样。
（李君豪:）
一道轻咳声打断了二人的交流。
“咳，不错，很帅。”李毅年看着黑衣少年与少年腰间的佩刀，眼神恍惚了一下夸奖着。
“君肃，我也有东西给你。”二长老也适时开口。
“拿着，这固血丹虽然便宜，但我可是往里面加了点东西，受伤了就吃下一颗，嘿嘿。”二长老说着说着，嘿嘿笑了起来。
“还有我，我也没什麽别的给你，拿着。”三长老敲了敲拐杖，递过一个黑色的小盒子。
“这是机关，里面的毒烟可以让大家境都短暂失去行动能力。”三长老得意说着。
李君肃看着黑盒子有些无语了，他发现了，二长老跟三长老都有些阴啊。
content_en:
The true nature of a person who leaves home is revealed.
Li family, early morning.
"Huh~ This technique is indeed the most simple." Li Junsu opened his eyes and thought as he looked at the bright sky outside.
The exercise that Li Qingfeng gave himself was called Qingxinzuizhi. The operation of the veins in the exercise was very detailed. He now felt that his whole body was much more transparent.
It's because the internal force is running through the whole body that you feel like this.
"No wonder there is a Great Zhoutian above the Small Zhoutian." Li Junsu stood up and said with a smile, then twisted his neck and pushed open the door.
After Li Junsu washed up, he began to think about the moves of the Spring Equinox Knife Technique again, then he pulled out Zhaohan and began to swing the knife a little sluggishly.
Li Yinian was right. Even if you can't get out of shape with a sword, it's better to practice getting out of shape first.
Even if it's just a simulated gun, one shot in your eye can blind you.
Li Junsu was always calm and gentle as jade in the Li family.
Get up, practice martial arts, always.
next day
"It's time to go." Li Junsu looked at the slightly bright sky outside, put on the clothes sewn by He Sui himself, carried a small package on his back, and opened the door.
Li family, lobby.
"Come on Junsu, come on." The elder looked at Li Junsu who entered the hall and waved.
"Great Elder?" Li Junsu stepped forward and spoke with some confusion.
"Take it." The elder took out a porcelain bottle and put it into Li Junsu's hand.
"Little" Li Junsu looked at the logo on the porcelain bottle and was about to speak when the elder hissed.
"Take it yourself. You have to practice harder outside." The great elder patted Li Junsu's hand.
He didn't want Li Junsu to join the Six Gates, but he also knew that this small Qingfeng City couldn't keep Li Junsu.
This place is too small, both in terms of resources and opponents.
He believed that Li Junsu would definitely become a hero.
Even if Li Junsu is not so ambitious, he still believes in it, just like he believes that Li Junhao can stand alone.
(Li Junhao:)
A slight cough interrupted the exchange between the two.
"Ahem, yes, he's very handsome." Li Yinian looked at the young man in black and the saber on his waist, and praised him with a trance in his eyes.
"Jun Su, I also have something for you." The second elder also spoke at the right time.
"Here, although this blood-solidifying pill is cheap, I added something to it. If you are injured, just take one, hehe." The second elder said and laughed.
"And me, I don't have anything else for you, take it." The third elder tapped his cane and handed over a small black box.
"This is a mechanism. The poisonous smoke inside can temporarily incapacitate everyone." The third elder said proudly.
Li Junsu was speechless when he looked at the black box. He discovered that both the second elder and the third elder were a little shady.
